tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Scientific Equipment and Laboratory Infrastructure for KITS Innovation Lab - 002
tenderSchedule.description: Procurement, supply, installation, commissioning and demonstration of scientific equipment, prototyping and 3D printing equipment, robotics and IoT development kits, AR/VR devices, display equipment, laboratory safety equipment and furniture for establishment and strengthening of the KITS Innovation Lab at Proudhadevaraya Institute of Technology PDIT, Hosapete, under the LEAP Initiative. The procurement includes necessary accessories, installation, operator training, warranty and after-sales support as specified in the tender document.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer should be a supplier, who has tested the products and authorized dealer. The equipment offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a supplier- The supplier furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract
In case of authorized representative/dealer of a supplier - The tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer, experience in suppling these materials in the similar domain
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.

The supplier shall provide comprehensive technical support, maintenance, troubleshooting and operational assistance for a minimum period of five (5) years from the date of installation and commissioning. The scope shall also include installation, hands-on training for faculty, staff and students, and periodic technical guidance to ensure effective utilisation of the laboratory. Further, the supplier shall assist the institution in developing and implementing a sustainable revenue-generation model
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.
A list giving full particulars, Specification, make, brand and warranty duration.

Item by item commentary on the Purchasers Technical Specifications demonstrating substantial responsiveness of the goods and services to those specifications or a statement of deviations and exceptions to the provisions of the Technical Specifications

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Company Registration and Statutory Documents Incorporation/Registration Certificate, GST Certificate, PAN and MSME Udyam Registration Certificate.
Experience Documents Relevant supply/installation work orders or experience certificates.
Financial Documents CA-certified turnover/financial statements and income-tax returns for the preceding three financial years, as applicable
Technical Documents OEM Authorization, where applicable, product brochures and technical compliance statement against Annexure-I of tender document.

Warranty and Support All equipment shall be supplied with the manufacturer warranty specified in Annexure-I. The successful bidder shall additionally provide technical assistance, maintenance coordination, operator training and after-sales support for a period of five years from the date of successful installation and commissioning. The scope, response times, service exclusions and any chargeable replacement parts shall be clearly declared.
